name: Stacey Plaskett
role: US Virgin Islands congressional delegate (since 2015) and 2026 gubernatorial nominee
summary: Plaskett advocates equal constitutional and voting rights for territorial residents, stronger social provision and climate investment. Her current territorial platform combines private investment, public infrastructure and union partnership.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Explicitly advocates higher federal and territorial minimum wages.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Would finance family investments by making wealthy taxpayers and large corporations contribute more.

unions-good.rationale: Celebrates labor organizing as a continuing source of liberty and social progress.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Supports preventing excessive drug-price increases and imposing community-benefit conditions on energy contracts.

cut-welfare.rationale: Condemns drastic SNAP cuts and insists on maintaining food assistance.

limit-guns.rationale: Advocates universal background checks, safe storage and assault-weapon restrictions.

empower-police-military.rationale: Would recruit more police at competitive pay and strengthen Caribbean military capacity.

rehabilitation.rationale: Explicitly supports criminal-justice programs aimed at reducing recidivism.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Explicitly defends gay people’s right to marry.

abortion-legal.rationale: Defends reproductive choice and codifying Roe’s protections.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Demands remedies for racist territorial exclusion and past discrimination against farmers of color.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Commits to preserving the Virgin Islands’ cultural heritage.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Praises historic federal climate investment and deep emissions reductions.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Supports large public investments in clean-energy manufacturing and infrastructure.

political-violence-never.rationale: Explicitly repudiates political violence at any time after correcting her Trump remark.

separate-church-state.rationale: Rejects imposing a particular religious belief through constitutional abortion adjudication.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: Seeks sustainable industrial development through modernized energy infrastructure.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Advocates an equitable two-state settlement for Israelis and Palestinians.

national-self-determination.rationale: Affirms territorial peoples’ right to choose their political future, without prescribing independence for all.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Condemns the racist constitutional reasoning associated with separate-but-equal segregation.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Affirms equal human standing and equal constitutional treatment for territorial residents.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Explicitly grounds just government in the consent of those governed.

priority-to-poor.rationale: Urges protecting vulnerable families and disadvantaged farmers when allocating public support.

minority-language-support.rationale: Would expand bilingual teaching capacity in territorial schools.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: Demands substantially greater humanitarian assistance for Palestinian civilians.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: Insists Trump face the same criminal accountability as other Americans.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Rejects permanent colonial subordination premised on supposedly inferior peoples.

local-production.rationale: Would require meaningful local food sourcing by government and tax-benefit hotels.

mixed-public-service-providers.rationale: Proposes publicly supported cooperation with nonprofits delivering wraparound care.

socialized-care.rationale: Supports publicly financed childcare and universal prekindergarten, without proposing collective provision of all housework.

social-market-economy.rationale: Combines private housing investment and economic development with publicly supported care and worker protections.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Explicitly supports funding, equipping and strengthening US armed forces.

property-franchise.rationale: Contrasts ancestors’ exclusion by land and income qualifications with her demand for equal voting rights.

racial-franchise.rationale: Demands equal voting rights against racialized territorial disenfranchisement.

open-government-data.rationale: Promises published agency goals, quarterly scorecards and tracked public feedback.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Would negotiate multiyear teacher pay and benefits with the AFT.

disputed-territory-plebiscite.rationale: Advocates a public territorial-status referendum with residents’ will paramount.

notes: The 2026 platform is the ticket she leads, not independent positions borrowed from her running mate. Status self-determination does not establish a universal right of secession or a personal preference for independence. Birthright citizenship is distinct from immigration levels. The energy plan combines public generation, possible private grid operation, renewables and transitional LNG; it does not establish domestic fuel-production policy or opposition to nuclear power. Her 2015 praise of anti-slavery resistance is historical; her later statement expressly rejects contemporary political violence. In 2024 she defended voluntary platform moderation and denied federal coercion. Separately, her 2023 perjury warning to Matt Taibbi was condemned by press-freedom advocates as intimidation; neither establishes a general doctrine that the ruling party should control media. The Epstein correspondence and censure controversy were checked; her defense of receiving constituent information supplies no clear position on the questionnaire’s business-privilege items. Affordable access, Medicaid support and hospital recruitment do not alone establish a guarantee of universal healthcare. Teacher tuition forgiveness does not establish cancellation of existing student loans. No views are inferred from party membership or employment.
